title: Scroll direction
description: up: key caps along the bottom, presses travel upwards. right: key caps down the left side, presses travel to the right.

title: Scroll speed / px per second
description: How fast presses travel along the tape, in pixels per real second (rate mods are compensated). 100–3000.

title: Lane width / px
description: Width of each key lane. Narrowed automatically when many mania columns would not fit; short lane sets widen so the header fits. 16–96.

title: Show press counts
description: Total presses of this attempt under each key label.

title: Show keys per second
description: Live keys per second (presses in the last real second across all keys) with a peak-hold meter; the results screen shows average and peak.

title: Smoke lane (osu!)
description: Adds a lane for the osu! smoke key.

title: osu! colour
description: Bar and key colour for osu! K1/K2.
